title: VIX futures & options October expiration (SOQ settlement) — the settlement that trails opex and prices the midterms
source: OCC: PROMOTED from estimate by this event's own initial research (docs/research/events/vix-expiration-2026-10-21.md, 2026-09-09) — the sanctioned venue for the flip, and the same move vix-expiration-2026-09-16, -2027-03-17, -2027-04-21 and -2027-05-18 made. THE LISTING: cboe.com/tradable_products/vix/vix_futures/ fetched direct 2026-09-09 (HTTP 200, 578,599 bytes) renders the market-data row `VX/V6 | 10/21/2026 | 18.41`. THE RULE, not just the listing: cboe.com/tradable_products/vix/vix_futures/specifications/ fetched direct the same day (HTTP 200, 461,361 bytes) states verbatim that final settlement is 'the Wednesday that is 30 days prior to the third Friday of the calendar month immediately following the month in which the contract expires'. November 2026's third Friday is 2026-11-20 (2026-11-01 is a Sunday, so the Fridays are the 6th, 13th, 20th and 27th); 2026-11-20 minus 30 days is Wednesday 2026-10-21, and neither that Wednesday nor 2026-11-20 is a Cboe Options holiday, so the specification's fallback clause does not fire. THIRD SURFACE, same day: cboe.com/us/futures/market_statistics/settlement/csv/?dt=2026-09-08 (HTTP 200) returns `VX,VX/V6,2026-10-21,18.402`, alongside VX/U6 2026-09-16 (16.6283), VX/X6 2026-11-18 (19.1354) and VX/Z6 2026-12-16 (19.2512). Applying the rule cold in scripts/research/vix-settlement-geometry.mjs reproduces all five of those listed dates independently. Settlement is the special opening quotation (VRO) struck in the 9:30 a.m. ET opening auction of a single SPX/SPXW series 30 days out — here the 2026-11-20 series. Supersedes proposals/vix-expiration-2026-10-21.from-opex-2026-10-16.json, which discovered the date on 2026-09-09 and correctly declined to self-confirm it. Checked 2026-09-09
notes: GEOMETRY, and it is the reason this entry is not a copy of vix-expiration-2026-09-16. Consecutive third Fridays are 28 or 35 days apart, so a VIX settlement lands on one of exactly two shapes against its own month's equity expiration: LEAD (28-day step, the Wednesday two days BEFORE the third Friday — September 2026) or TRAIL (35-day step, the Wednesday five days AFTER — this one, and next 2027-01-20). September's ledger built its framing on the lead shape; October inverts it. THE HOUSE MEASUREMENT SAYS THE INVERSION DOES NOT MATTER: scripts/research/vix-settlement-geometry.mjs, built and run 2026-09-09 on Cboe's own VIX history plus the expiration-displacement basket, finds settlement sessions indistinguishable from ordinary sessions on |dVIX| (median 0.795 vs 0.680 all-session, n=248 vs 5,235, permutation P = 0.063) and finds NO lead-vs-trail difference on either measure — |dVIX| P = 0.647 raw / 0.341 in 2013+, basket relative volume P = 0.088 raw / 0.206 in 2013+, with trail the LOWER side where it flirts at all. THE STRIP, which is the part that is real and unmeasured: the VRO is struck off the single 2026-11-20 SPX series, so this settlement fixes a 30-day reading of 2026-10-21 -> 2026-11-20 — a window carrying fomc-2026-10-28, gdp-q3-2026-advance and pce-2026-10-29, eci-q3-2026-10-30, midterm-elections-2026-11-03, jobs-2026-11-06, cpi-2026-11-10, us-china-tariff-truce-expiry-2026-11-10, ppi-2026-11-13, retail-sales-2026-11-17 and opex-2026-11-20 itself. Among monthly VX contracts it is the ONLY one whose measurement window contains the 2026 midterms. The curve does not show that as a local premium: on 2026-09-08 settlements the term structure is monotone contango (cash 15.72, U6 16.6283, V6 18.402, X6 19.1354, Z6 19.2512), so V6 carries no hump against the post-election X6. Impact low matches every other vix-expiration entry; symbols is empty and no house playbook (S1/S2/E1/S3/S4/G1) is expiration- or vol-settlement-keyed. Now confirmed, which licenses date-keyed caution and still no entry.
